checks.detail: Icarus 12 compiler return code 139; supplemental Icarus 11 compilation succeeded with always_* sensitivity warnings.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.

Original diagram duplicates the no-request condition for A-to-D and omits D transitions. Implemented the prose: device 2 receives a grant when it is the only requester and retains it while r[2] is asserted.
No synthesis or board verification performed.

justified_rtl_changes.reason: Compatibility correction after Icarus 12 compilation crash and inspection of supplemental diagnostics.
justified_rtl_changes.change: Replaced enum state type with explicit two-bit localparam codes and always_comb with always @*. FSM transitions, synchronous reset, interface and output timing are preserved.

interface_cycle_semantics: TopModule(clk, resetn, r[2:0], g[2:0]); active-low synchronous reset to idle, positive-edge transitions, Moore grants, release enters idle before arbitration on a later edge.
static_review: Separate combinational state table and sequential state register, nonblocking sequential assignment, complete combinational assignments, two-bit state and three-bit grant widths, no added ports or pipeline latency.
testbench_coverage: All 64 pairs of request patterns from idle and each grant state; pre-edge output stability; grant priority, retention, release, repeated synchronous resets; bounded timeout.
